verdict.rationale: mParticle publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 YAML spec for its Events API and explicitly recommends it for generating SDKs with OpenAPI Generator. That spec covers only the Events API; the docs note that the Platform and Profile API pages carry no spec, so much of the API surface lacks machine-readable definitions. missing for 10: OpenAPI specs for the Platform, Profile and other APIs (e.g. DSR, Warehouse Sync), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Use the Open API (previously known as Swagger) specification or similar tools to generate helper SDKs (using Swagger Codegen or OpenAPI Generator) for the Events API: Events API Open API Spec.
The spec file itself downloads as OpenAPI 3.0.3 YAML
